capabilities: Analyze key questions and artwork with AI
disambiguation: Not a Git or code repository manager; it organizes study materials and learning notes.
extras: Requires third-party AI service accounts; artwork analysis needs a multimodal model. README has English and Chinese versions.
motivation: Built as a gift for the author's daughter Xiaoyu to record her growth and learning.
problem: Students and parents lack one place to organize test papers, notes, vocabulary and artwork and to get AI help analyzing them.

relations.evidence: Baidu Cloud General Text Recognition (High-precision Version): Register introduction

summary: AI study assistant that turns test-paper images into Markdown, extracts text, and supports English learning and question analysis.
